verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SDK or client library for kitty. What it does document is a remote-control CLI (`kitten @`), verified hands-on, and a Python extension mechanism (kittens). These are a CLI and a plugin surface rather than SDKs for building against the product, so they count only as adjacent features, and no OpenAPI spec or SDK packages appear anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
